families.entry: HTF bullish/bearish alignment -> controlled pullback into dynamic trend zone -> close resumes trend / local structure break on entry timeframe
families.regime: trade only directional regime; reject flat/conflicting HTF structure
families.exit: initial structure/volatility target; runner/trailing is later single-axis ablation only
families.cost_hurdle: projected move to first objective must exceed round-trip fee+slippage+buffer
families.no_trade: HTF conflict, compression without resumption, projected edge <= cost hurdle

families.entry: compression/range -> close beyond prior channel/range -> expansion magnitude confirmed relative to volatility
families.regime: prefer aligned or emerging directional regime; reject exhausted/overextended breakout
families.invalidation: opposite side of breakout structure or ATR-normalized stop
families.exit: opposite channel break or volatility/time stop; target variant tested separately
families.cost_hurdle: breakout expected continuation distance must exceed all-in trading cost buffer
families.no_trade: inside range, weak expansion, projected edge <= cost hurdle

families.entry: sweep of prior swing/liquidity boundary -> close reclaims level -> momentum/volume confirmation tested only as single-axis variants
families.regime: reversal allowed only at defined liquidity boundary; avoid mid-range fades
families.invalidation: beyond sweep extreme with volatility normalization
families.exit: opposite range/volume-profile reference or fixed structure objective; time stop if reclaim stalls
families.cost_hurdle: distance to conservative objective must exceed all-in trading cost buffer
families.no_trade: no true sweep/reclaim, mid-range, weak reclaim, projected edge <= cost hurdle

families.entry: 1h/4h structure defines direction and invalidation; 5m/15m break-retest/resumption supplies execution
families.regime: HTF structure must be unambiguous; LTF setup cannot override conflicting HTF
families.invalidation: HTF thesis invalidation translated to ATR-normalized LTF risk
families.exit: next HTF liquidity/structure objective with optional trailing tested later
families.cost_hurdle: HTF-to-target distance after conservative haircut must exceed all-in costs
families.no_trade: HTF ambiguous/conflicting, LTF chase without retest, projected edge <= cost hurdle

families.entry: directional momentum signal becomes tradeable only when estimated move magnitude clears transaction-cost threshold
families.regime: momentum persistence must agree with regime; reject low-signal/noise zone
families.invalidation: momentum failure plus volatility-normalized price stop
families.exit: momentum decay/time stop; target/trailing compared one at a time
families.cost_hurdle: hard prerequisite derived from fee+slippage+funding assumptions, not a cosmetic score
families.no_trade: signal magnitude <= cost threshold or regime conflict
